description: What decides whether the pull requests into e4/gated, one for each merge state, can merge, as rozed-bot, which opened them and administers rozed-dev/e2e, read only. e4/gated has no classic protection; its ruleset, with no bypass actors, requires a pull request with one approval, a code owner's review (rozed-bot owns every file) and every conversation resolved, and the ci check from GitHub Actions (app 15368), not strict. #25: ci passed, waiting on an approval. #26: ci failed. #27: ci passed at rest, after its 10-minute run, with a run started by hand beside it that GitHub doesn't count. #28: conflicts, so no workflow ran and ci never reported. #29: a draft, which GitHub reports BLOCKED. #30: one conversation unresolved, with reviewDecision null after rozed-bot's COMMENT review
